senses.definition: n.f. prob. flowing stream, only Ju 12:6 dial. form of i. שִׁבֹּלֶת (> ear of wheat); cf. MarquardtZAW viii (1888), 151 ff. but also GFM Bu; v. I. שִׁבֹּלֶת.
